name: Lauren Miller
reason: Now Lauren Ash: blackgirlinom.com redirects to wellnessinchrist.com, and her own site hellolaurenash.com says she has left Black Girl in Om (which she now describes as built on a 'misaligned spiritual foundation') to run Wellness in Christ, a Christian women's wellness brand (scripture journal, gatherings, products). She no longer teaches meditation and the work is a brand rather than a teacher listing. (An email, lauren@wellnessinchrist.com, is published on hellolaurenash.com.)
